def _upsert_raw_document_sync(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註 [doc_id 幽靈化修正]：補上 RETURNING doc_id，比照
            # _get_or_create_graph_node_sync／_get_or_create_graph_edge_sync
            # 同一模式——UNIQUE 鍵是 source_uri，ON CONFLICT 分支不覆蓋
            # doc_id，呼叫端傳入的 doc_id 在併發競態下可能不等於這一列
            # 實際落地的 doc_id。過去完全不回報真相，呼叫端會拿著一個
            # 查無對應列的幽靈 doc_id 繼續動作且無任何錯誤訊號。
            cur = conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO raw_documents
                    (doc_id, source_type, source_uri, title, raw_text, content_hash,
                     fetched_at, extra_json, source_credibility, evidence_polarity, asset_ids_json,
                     chunking_source, trace_id)
                VALUES (:doc_id, :source_type, :source_uri, :title, :raw_text, :content_hash,
                        :fetched_at, :extra_json, :source_credibility, :evidence_polarity, :asset_ids_json,
                        :chunking_source, :trace_id)
                ON CONFLICT(source_uri) DO UPDATE SET
                    title=excluded.title,
                    raw_text=excluded.raw_text,
                    content_hash=excluded.content_hash,
                    fetched_at=excluded.fetched_at,
                    extra_json=excluded.extra_json,
                    source_credibility=excluded.source_credibility,
                    evidence_polarity=excluded.evidence_polarity,
                    asset_ids_json=excluded.asset_ids_json,
                    chunking_source=excluded.chunking_source,
                    trace_id=excluded.trace_id
                RETURNING doc_id
                """,
                row,
            )
            resolved_doc_id = cur.fetchone()[0]
            conn.commit()
            return resolved_doc_id
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def upsert_raw_document(
    *,
    doc_id: str,
    source_type: str,
    source_uri: str,
    title: str,
    raw_text: str,
    content_hash: str,
    fetched_at: float,
    extra: dict[str, Any],
    source_credibility: float,
    evidence_polarity: str,
    asset_ids: list[str],
    chunking_source: str,
    trace_id: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """
    回傳值（doc_id 幽靈化修正）：這一列在資料庫裡實際落地的 doc_id。
    併發時可能不等於呼叫端傳入的 doc_id 參數——UNIQUE 鍵是 source_uri，
    ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE 不覆蓋既有 doc_id。呼叫端（intake.py）必須
    改用這個回傳值校正後續所有動作，不能再假設傳入值等於最終落地值。

    備註：UNIQUE 鍵為 source_uri 而非 content_hash（與決策總帳「原代碼對
    content_hash 設 UNIQUE 會導致內容更新時 UPSERT 失效」的結論一致），
    確保同網址內容更新時能正確覆蓋既有紀錄，而非產生重複資料列。

    evidence_polarity 收裸字串（EvidencePolarity.value），不收 Enum——
    比照本檔案「database 層零業務邏輯，不認識 schemas Enum」的既有約束
    （見 intake.py 對 upsert_raw_asset 的同一慣例說明），型別轉換責任在
    呼叫端。

    chunking_source（問題四修正）：必填、無預設值——比照 evidence_polarity
    的既有紀律，強制每個呼叫端顯式指定。不給預設值是刻意的：這個欄位
    先前完全沒有持久化，任何從 SQLite 現況重建 RawDocument 的路徑都會
    悄悄拿到 "auto_llm"，改變 processor.py 的分支判斷（見該檔案
    `if doc.chunking_source == "human_reviewed":`）。若這裡給一個看似
    安全的預設值，未來某個新呼叫端忘記傳遞時只會靜默重演同一種錯誤，
    不會有任何錯誤訊號。

    trace_id 為可選關鍵字參數，預設 None——舊呼叫端（若存在）行為不變。
    intake.py 的 ingest_manual_feed() 是首個生產者，理應傳入自己生成
    的 trace_id；同一 source_uri 重新匯入時，本次的 trace_id 會覆蓋
    舊值（比照 title/raw_text 等其餘欄位的既有覆蓋語意），代表「最近一次
    匯入的追蹤線索」，不是歷史累積清單。
    """
    row = {
        "doc_id": doc_id,
        "source_type": source_type,
        "source_uri": source_uri,
        "title": title,
        "raw_text": raw_text,
        "content_hash": content_hash,
        "fetched_at": fetched_at,
        "extra_json": _json_dumps(extra),
        "source_credibility": source_credibility,
        "evidence_polarity": evidence_polarity,
        "asset_ids_json": _json_dumps(asset_ids),
        "chunking_source": chunking_source,
        "trace_id": trace_id,
    }
    return await _run_write(_upsert_raw_document_sync, row)


def _get_raw_document_sync(doc_id: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        cur = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM raw_documents WHERE doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        data = dict(zip(cols, row))
    data["extra"] = _json_loads(data.pop("extra_json"))
    data["asset_ids"] = _json_loads(data.pop("asset_ids_json"))
    return data

def _finalize_processing_with_chunks_sync(
    doc_id: str,
    total_chunks: int,
    stage_value: str,
    chunk_rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> None:
    conn = _get_connection()
    now = time.time()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註：INSERT OR IGNORE 比照 chunk_id 確定性生成的既有冪等
            # 慣例——同一份 Dispatcher 重試不會產生重複列。executemany
            # 與下方 UPDATE 同一交易，消滅「Chunk 已落地、pipeline_stage
            # 卻還沒推進」的殘餘崩潰窗口。
            if chunk_rows:
                conn.executemany(
                    """
                    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO document_chunks
                        (chunk_id, parent_doc_id, concept, text, seq_index,
                         chunking_strategy, source_type, credibility_score, evidence_polarity)
                    VALUES
                        (:chunk_id, :parent_doc_id, :concept, :text, :seq_index,
                         :chunking_strategy, :source_type, :credibility_score, :evidence_polarity)
                    """,
                    chunk_rows,
                )
            # 備註 [管線監控]：chunked_at 就是「這個函式被呼叫」這個瞬間的
            # 定義——不論後面走 PROCESSED 常規路徑或零 Chunk 直達
            # GRAPH_MAPPED 的快速路徑，切塊工作在這裡都已經完成。mapped_at
            # 只在零 Chunk 快速路徑（stage_value 直接是 GRAPH_MAPPED）才
            # 一併寫入，因為這種情況不會經過
            # _record_chunk_and_maybe_advance_sync，那裡才是常規路徑寫
            # mapped_at 的唯一地方（見下方對應修改）。
            if stage_value == Stage.GRAPH_MAPPED.value:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE raw_documents SET pipeline_stage = ?, total_chunks = ?, "
                    "chunked_at = ?, mapped_at = ? WHERE doc_id = ?",
                    (stage_value, total_chunks, now, now, doc_id),
                )
            else:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE raw_documents SET pipeline_stage = ?, total_chunks = ?, "
                    "chunked_at = ? WHERE doc_id = ?",
                    (stage_value, total_chunks, now, doc_id),
                )
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def finalize_processing_with_chunks(
    *,
    doc_id: str,
    total_chunks: int,
    stage: Stage,
    chunks: list[Any],  # list[Chunk]，呼叫端已排除 DOCUMENT_SUMMARY
) -> None:
    """
    取代舊版 finalize_processing。將 document_chunks 落地與
    pipeline_stage/total_chunks 推進合併進單一 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 交易，
    對外必須是同一個原子事實，不能被觀察到中間狀態
    （見決策總帳「知識污染」防禦鏈的最後一塊拼圖）。

    呼叫端責任：
    1. chunks 參數必須已排除 chunking_strategy=DOCUMENT_SUMMARY
       （零業務邏輯約束，過濾邏輯屬 processor.py）。
    2. total_chunks 必須是 len(chunks)（即排除摘要後的數量），與
       record_chunk_graph_progress 的 GRAPH_MAPPED 判斷分母口徑一致——
       若含摘要計數，分子永遠追不上分母，文件會永久卡在 PROCESSED
       （見決策總帳「total_chunks 語意收斂」條目）。
    """
    chunk_rows = [
        {
            "chunk_id": c.chunk_id,
            "parent_doc_id": c.parent_doc_id,
            "concept": c.concept,
            "text": c.text,
            "seq_index": c.seq_index,
            "chunking_strategy": c.chunking_strategy.value,
            "source_type": c.source_type,
            "credibility_score": c.credibility_score,
            "evidence_polarity": c.evidence_polarity.value,
        }
        for c in chunks
    ]
    await _run_write(
        _finalize_processing_with_chunks_sync, doc_id, total_chunks, stage.value, chunk_rows
    )


async def revert_stage(doc_id: str, stage: Stage) -> None:
    """
    備註：實作上與 update_stage 完全相同的 SQL 操作，刻意保留獨立函式名稱，
    是為了在呼叫端（Worker 的 CancelledError 回滾區塊）清楚表達語意——
    這裡是「防護性倒退」而非「正常推進」，方便未來讀 log/trace 時快速辨識意圖。
    """
    await _run_write(_update_stage_sync, doc_id, stage.value)

def _record_chunk_and_maybe_advance_sync(doc_id: str, chunk_id: str, status: str, target_stage: str) -> bool:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註：改用 OR IGNORE，符合「同一證據不重複計數」與「先到者得」的冪等哲學。
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_build_progress (doc_id, chunk_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (doc_id, chunk_id, status)
            )
            
            cur = conn.execute("SELECT total_chunks FROM raw_documents WHERE doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            
            # 備註：嚴格分離資料完整性錯誤與合法競態
            if row is None:
                raise sqlite3.IntegrityError(f"graph_build_progress 寫入時查無 doc_id={doc_id} 的 raw_documents 紀錄")
            if row[0] is None:
                conn.commit()
                return False
                
            total_chunks = row[0]
            cur = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graph_build_progress WHERE doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))
            processed_chunks = cur.fetchone()[0]
            
            advanced = False
            if processed_chunks >= total_chunks:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE raw_documents SET pipeline_stage = ?, mapped_at = ? "
                    "WHERE doc_id = ? AND pipeline_stage != ?",
                    (target_stage, time.time(), doc_id, target_stage)
                )
                advanced = True
                
            conn.commit()
            return advanced
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise

# 備註：星號 (*) 強制呼叫端必須使用關鍵字參數，防堵 doc_id 與 chunk_id 錯位
async def record_chunk_graph_progress(*, doc_id: str, chunk_id: str, status: Stage) -> bool:
    """記錄 Chunk 終態並自動檢查是否滿足 GRAPH_MAPPED 推進條件"""
    return await _run_write(_record_chunk_and_maybe_advance_sync, doc_id, chunk_id, status.value, Stage.GRAPH_MAPPED.value)


def _record_chunk_tombstone_sync(
    doc_id: str, chunk_id: str, status: str, target_stage: str, consumed_at: float
) -> bool:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註 [雙帳同步修正]：graph_build_progress 終態寫入與
            # graph_image_batch_buffer.consumed_at 標記，原本由呼叫端分兩次
            # 獨立呼叫（各自獨立交易），中間若發生行程崩潰會留下第一本帳
            # 已終結、第二本帳仍卡 consumed_at IS NULL 的殭屍列（2026-08
            # ops_hub 積壓數字卡死事故根因）。併入同一交易，對外成為單一
            # 不可分割事實，比照 finalize_processing_with_chunks 的既有模式。
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO graph_build_progress (doc_id, chunk_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (doc_id, chunk_id, status),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE graph_image_batch_buffer SET consumed_at = ? WHERE chunk_id = ?",
                (consumed_at, chunk_id),
            )

            cur = conn.execute("SELECT total_chunks FROM raw_documents WHERE doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()

            # 備註：嚴格分離資料完整性錯誤與合法競態，比照 _record_chunk_and_maybe_advance_sync。
            if row is None:
                raise sqlite3.IntegrityError(f"graph_build_progress 寫入時查無 doc_id={doc_id} 的 raw_documents 紀錄")
            if row[0] is None:
                conn.commit()
                return False

            total_chunks = row[0]
            cur = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graph_build_progress WHERE doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))
            processed_chunks = cur.fetchone()[0]

            advanced = False
            if processed_chunks >= total_chunks:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE raw_documents SET pipeline_stage = ?, mapped_at = ? "
                    "WHERE doc_id = ? AND pipeline_stage != ?",
                    (target_stage, time.time(), doc_id, target_stage),
                )
                advanced = True

            conn.commit()
            return advanced
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def record_chunk_tombstone(*, doc_id: str, chunk_id: str, status: Stage, consumed_at: float) -> bool:
    """
    死信終結專用：取代 store_manager._handle_chunk_tombstone 原本分開呼叫
    record_chunk_graph_progress + mark_buffered_chunks_consumed 的寫法。
    僅供 Chunk Tombstone 路徑使用——一般建圖成功路徑仍呼叫
    record_chunk_graph_progress（該路徑的消耗標記在批次組圖當下已由
    mark_buffered_chunks_consumed 處理，不需要改動）。
    """
    return await _run_write(

    )

async def is_chunk_graph_processed(*, doc_id: str, chunk_id: str) -> bool:
    """
    決策總帳條目四十修正：查詢單一 chunk 是否已在 graph_build_progress
    留有終態紀錄。供 graph_engine._process_chunk() 在呼叫 LLM 之前的
    冪等性前置檢查使用——實際查帳單確認，同一顆 chunk 因上游任何原因
    （recovery sweep 重複派發、stalled_intake 整份重跑等）被重複送進
    GRAPH_BUILDER 佇列時，過去只有最終寫入（record_chunk_graph_progress
    的 INSERT OR IGNORE）受到保護，_extract_candidates() 的 LLM 呼叫本身
    完全沒有防線，每次重複派發都會重新花費一次呼叫成本——這才是實測
    帳單異常的主要來源，不是先前推測的圖片描述。

    純讀取查詢。查詢本身失敗（如 sqlite3.Error）原樣往上拋，交由
    dispatcher.py 的 worker_loop 分類為一般 API_ERROR 重試——刻意不在此
    吞噬例外、不假設「查不到就代表未處理」，避免在真正的資料庫異常時
    誤判為未處理而繼續執行昂貴的 LLM 呼叫，讓這道防線在最需要它的時候
    失效。
    """
    return await _run_read(_is_chunk_graph_processed_sync, doc_id, chunk_id)

async def upsert_raw_assets_batch(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    """
    批次版本的 upsert_raw_asset：多筆 raw_assets 列在單一 BEGIN IMMEDIATE
    交易內原子寫入，全部成功才提交，任一筆失敗全部回滾。

    比照 finalize_processing_with_chunks()／record_chunk_tombstone() 的
    既有「合併進單一交易，對外成為不可分割事實」設計精神——呼叫端
    （intake.py）原本逐筆 await upsert_raw_asset() 的寫法，若迴圈中途
    失敗，之前已成功的幾筆會殘留在 raw_assets，但 raw_documents.
    asset_ids_json 已在更早的 upsert_raw_document() 呼叫中把全部 N 個
    asset_id 一併落地，兩者從此對不上，且沒有任何機制會補上缺的那幾筆。
    改為批次寫入後，失敗只有兩種結果：全部落地，或完全不落地——後者
    才是既有 _AssetNotReady 自癒重試機制原本就預期要處理的情境，不再
    有「部分落地」這種兩種機制都沒設計來因應的中間狀態。

    每個 row dict 的欄位形狀與 upsert_raw_asset() 內部組裝的 row 完全
    一致（含 .value 轉換後的裸字串），型別轉換責任仍在呼叫端，本函式
    沿用既有「database 層零業務邏輯」約束，不在此處反過來認識 schemas
    的 Enum 定義。

    空清單直接返回、不開交易——無圖片附件的文件不需要為此特判。
    """
    if not rows:
        return
    await _run_write(_upsert_raw_assets_batch_sync, rows)

def _get_or_create_graph_node_sync(node_id: str, canonical_name: str, created_at: float) -> str:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註：ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE SET canonical_name=canonical_name
            # 是刻意的無意義自我賦值，純粹是為了讓 RETURNING 在衝突時也能拿到
            # 既有列的 node_id。兩個 Worker 平行處理不同 Chunk、同時判定同一個
            # 實體名稱是新節點時，誰先誰後都會拿到同一個正確的 node_id，不需要
            # 應用層寫 try/except IntegrityError 後重查的補丁邏輯——TOCTOU
            # 競態直接推給資料庫的 ACID 保證處理。
            cur = conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO graph_nodes (node_id, canonical_name, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT(canonical_name) DO UPDATE SET canonical_name = canonical_name
                RETURNING node_id
                """,
                (node_id, canonical_name, created_at),
            )
            resolved_node_id = cur.fetchone()[0]
            conn.commit()
            return resolved_node_id
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise

def _get_pipeline_status_snapshot_sync() -> dict[str, Any]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        cur = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT
                d.doc_id, d.title, d.pipeline_stage, d.total_chunks,
                d.fetched_at, d.chunked_at, d.embedded_at, d.mapped_at, d.trace_id,
                (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graph_build_progress p WHERE p.doc_id = d.doc_id) AS graph_progressed
            FROM raw_documents d
            ORDER BY d.fetched_at DESC
            LIMIT 50
            """
        )
        cols = [c[0] for c in cur.description]
        docs = [dict(zip(cols, row)) for row in cur.fetchall()]

        stage_counts_cur = conn.execute(
            "SELECT pipeline_stage, COUNT(*) FROM raw_documents GROUP BY pipeline_stage"
        )
        stage_counts = dict(stage_counts_cur.fetchall())
        
        # 備註：補充全域失敗文件數 KPI。因 pipeline_stage 已不再標記 graph_failed_permanent，
        # 改從終態紀錄表即時統計「至少有一顆 chunk 永久失敗」的文件數。
        failed_docs_cur = conn.execute(
            "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT doc_id) FROM graph_build_progress WHERE status = 'graph_failed_permanent'"
        )
        stage_counts["graph_failed_permanent"] = failed_docs_cur.fetchone()[0]

    return {"documents": docs, "stage_counts": stage_counts}

    graph_progressed 是 graph_build_progress 裡已記錄終態的 chunk 數，

def _get_or_create_graph_edge_sync(
    edge_id: str,
    source_node_id: str,
    relation: str,
    target_node_id: str,
    is_tension: bool,
    verification_status: str,
    extractor_version: str,
    base_confidence: float,
    created_at: float,
) -> str:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註：與 get_or_create_graph_node 同一模式，靠 UNIQUE(source_node_id,
            # relation, target_node_id) 約束解決「兩個 Worker 同時判定同一組
            # 三元組是新邊」的 TOCTOU 競態。confidence 與 base_confidence 在
            # 建立當下相同（corroboration_count=0 時尚未有任何佐證加成，
            # 對應 record_edge_evidence() 公式 log(1+0)=0 的基準狀態）；
            # 後續佐證一律透過 record_edge_evidence() 的獨立原子交易更新，
            # 此函式建立後不再重複呼叫。is_tension 是 relation 本身的靜態
            # 屬性（見 schemas/relation_taxonomy.py），建立當下決定後永不需要
            # 事後更新，不是動態的兩邊比對結果。
            cur = conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO graph_edges
                    (edge_id, source_node_id, relation, target_node_id, is_tension,
                     verification_status, extractor_version, base_confidence, confidence,
                     corroboration_count, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?)
                ON CONFLICT(source_node_id, relation, target_node_id)
                    DO UPDATE SET edge_id = edge_id
                RETURNING edge_id
                """,
                (
                    edge_id, source_node_id, relation, target_node_id, int(is_tension),
                    verification_status, extractor_version, base_confidence, base_confidence, created_at,
                ),
            )
            resolved_edge_id = cur.fetchone()[0]
            conn.commit()
            return resolved_edge_id
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def get_or_create_graph_edge(
    *,
    edge_id: str,

    verification_status: str,
    extractor_version: str,
    base_confidence: float,
    created_at: float,
) -> str:
    """
    建立新邊，或在併發衝突下回傳既有邊的 edge_id（同上 get_or_create_graph_node
    的競態處理模式）。回傳的 edge_id 不代表這次一定是新建立——呼叫端接下來
    應無條件呼叫 record_edge_evidence() 記錄本次 Chunk 的佐證，讓該函式的
    INSERT OR IGNORE 去重機制決定這次佐證是否需要真的計數。
    """
    return await _run_write(

    )


def _record_edge_evidence_sync(edge_id: str, chunk_id: str, k: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註：INSERT OR IGNORE 讓「同一 chunk_id 是否已計數過」變成
            # PRIMARY KEY 約束的原子判斷。cursor.rowcount 在真正插入新列時
            # 為 1，在因主鍵衝突被忽略時為 0——這是判斷本次是否為「新佐證」
            # 的確定性依據，不需要先查詢陣列內容做 in 判斷。
            cur = conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO edge_source_chunks (edge_id, chunk_id) VALUES (?, ?)",
                (edge_id, chunk_id),
            )
            is_new_evidence = cur.rowcount == 1

            cur = conn.execute(
                "SELECT base_confidence, confidence, corroboration_count "
                "FROM graph_edges WHERE edge_id = ?",
                (edge_id,),
            )
            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise sqlite3.IntegrityError(
                    f"edge_source_chunks 寫入時查無 edge_id={edge_id} 的 graph_edges 紀錄"
                )
            base_confidence, confidence, corroboration_count = row

            if not is_new_evidence:
                conn.commit()
                return {
                    "confidence": confidence,
                    "corroboration_count": corroboration_count,
                    "evidence_added": False,
                }

            # 備註：new_confidence 永遠以不可變的 base_confidence 為基準
            # 重算，不是拿上一次的 confidence 當 base——否則會變成複利式
            # 暴衝，幾次佐證後所有邊都會頂到 1.0。
            new_count = corroboration_count + 1
            new_confidence = min(base_confidence * (1 + math.log(1 + new_count) * k), 1.0)
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE graph_edges SET corroboration_count = ?, confidence = ? WHERE edge_id = ?",
                (new_count, new_confidence, edge_id),
            )
            conn.commit()
            return {
                "confidence": new_confidence,
                "corroboration_count": new_count,
                "evidence_added": True,
            }
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def record_edge_evidence(*, edge_id: str, chunk_id: str, k: float = 0.2) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    解決 corroboration_count 讀寫競態與 document_sources 的非原子重複計數
    檢查：把「記錄佐證來源、判斷是否為新佐證、若是則依對數公式重算
    confidence」包在單一 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 交易內完成。

    備註 [決策總帳「Gap H」]：此函式必須由 graph_engine.py 直接呼叫，
    不透過 RAW_STORE 的 Envelope 佇列——比照 processor.py 直接呼叫
    sqlite_client.update_stage()/finalize_processing() 的既有慣例。若改走
    Envelope 扇出，「讀取→算新值→排入佇列」之間的等待視窗會讓這裡想解決
    的競態換個地方重演。

    k 為對數加成係數，決策總帳建議從 0.2 開始，依實際資料調整。
    """
    return await _run_write(_record_edge_evidence_sync, edge_id, chunk_id, k)


def _find_graph_edge_by_triple_sync(
    source_node_id: str, relation: str, target_node_id: str

        row = cur.fetchone()

def _sweep_orphaned_edges_sync(chunk_ids: list[str], k: float) -> dict[str, int]:
    if not chunk_ids:
        return {"edges_deleted": 0, "edges_updated": 0}

    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 步驟一：批次找出受影響的 edge_id，必須在刪除前查，否則失去
            # 比對依據。SQLite 單次語句變數上限 999，分批處理。
            affected_edge_ids: set[str] = set()
            for i in range(0, len(chunk_ids), 500):
                batch = chunk_ids[i : i + 500]
                placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
                cur = conn.execute(
                    f"SELECT DISTINCT edge_id FROM edge_source_chunks "
                    f"WHERE chunk_id IN ({placeholders})",
                    batch,
                )
                affected_edge_ids.update(row[0] for row in cur.fetchall())

            # 步驟二：批次刪除本次受災 chunk_id 的佐證來源紀錄。chunk_id
            # 本身已足夠定位要刪的列，不需再帶 edge_id 條件。
            for i in range(0, len(chunk_ids), 500):
                batch = chunk_ids[i : i + 500]
                placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
                conn.execute(
                    f"DELETE FROM edge_source_chunks WHERE chunk_id IN ({placeholders})", batch
                )

            # 步驟三：逐邊重新計算或刪除。
            edges_deleted = 0
            edges_updated = 0
            for edge_id in affected_edge_ids:
                cur = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edge_source_chunks WHERE edge_id = ?", (edge_id,)
                )
                remaining_count = cur.fetchone()[0]

                if remaining_count == 0:
                    # edge_review_flags 沒有 ON DELETE CASCADE 宣告（即使
                    # 開了 FK 執行也不會），必須顯式刪除，避免留下指向
                    # 不存在 edge_id 的孤兒審查標記。
                    conn.execute("DELETE FROM edge_review_flags WHERE edge_id = ?", (edge_id,))
                    conn.execute("DELETE FROM graph_edges WHERE edge_id = ?", (edge_id,))
                    edges_deleted += 1
                else:
                    cur = conn.execute(
                        "SELECT base_confidence FROM graph_edges WHERE edge_id = ?", (edge_id,)
                    )
                    row = cur.fetchone()
                    if row is None:
                        raise sqlite3.IntegrityError(
                            f"edge_source_chunks 殘留 edge_id={edge_id} 但 graph_edges 查無此列"
                        )
                    base_confidence = row[0]
                    # 備註：與 _record_edge_evidence_sync 使用同一套對數
                    # 加成公式、同一個不可變 base_confidence 基準，確保
                    # 佐證路徑與剔除路徑的信心度語意對稱一致。
                    new_confidence = min(
                        base_confidence * (1 + math.log(1 + remaining_count) * k), 1.0
                    )
                    conn.execute(
                        "UPDATE graph_edges SET corroboration_count = ?, confidence = ? "
                        "WHERE edge_id = ?",
                        (remaining_count, new_confidence, edge_id),
                    )
                    edges_updated += 1

            conn.commit()
            return {"edges_deleted": edges_deleted, "edges_updated": edges_updated}
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def sweep_orphaned_edges(chunk_ids: list[str], k: float = 0.2) -> dict[str, int]:
    """
    針對一批受災 chunk_id，剔除其在 edge_source_chunks 的佐證紀錄，並依
    剩餘來源數重算或刪除對應的 graph_edges。

    必須在 purge_document_and_chunks() 之前呼叫：本函式只依賴 chunk_id
    字串本身，不要求 document_chunks 列還存在，這讓「先 sweep 後
    purge」的順序在腳本中斷後重跑依然安全——document_chunks 尚未被刪，
    重新讀取仍能拿到同一份 chunk_id 清單。批次刪除與依 COUNT(*) 重算皆
    為冪等操作，重跑一次結果不變。

    k 須與 record_edge_evidence() 使用同一個對數加成係數，兩者共用同一
    套 confidence 語意。
    """
    return await _run_write(_sweep_orphaned_edges_sync, chunk_ids, k)


def _batched(items: list[str], size: int = 500):
    """SQLite 單次語句變數上限 999，IN 清單一律分批（比照 sweep_orphaned_edges 既有做法）。"""
    for i in range(0, len(items), size):
        yield items[i : i + size]


def _cascade_release_in_txn(conn: sqlite3.Connection, doc_id: str, l2_ids_to_release: list[str]) -> None:
    """
    文件級聯 purge 的 SQLite 側清理，必須在呼叫端已開啟的 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 交易內
    執行，與後續三個 DELETE 同一個原子事實。

    chunk_id 只由 doc_id + seq_index 決定（processor._build_chunks），purge 後重新
    匯入會讓相同 chunk_id 對應到不同內容，下列以 chunk_id 為鍵的殘留都會因此錯位。
    """
    chunk_ids = [
        r[0] for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT chunk_id FROM document_chunks WHERE parent_doc_id = ?", (doc_id,)
        ).fetchall()
    ]

    # 1. 一致性檢查：交易內重新計算受影響的自動 L2。呼叫端是在交易之外算出
    #    l2_ids_to_release 並已刪除對應的 Chroma 卡片，若兩者之間又有新的 L2 接受
    #    覆蓋了這些 chunk，這裡會發現「還有沒被釋放的 L2」，整個交易回滾，
    #    避免留下「卡片在向量庫、coverage 卻已被清掉」的最糟狀態。重跑即可（冪等）。
    affected_l2_ids: set[str] = set()
    for batch in _batched(chunk_ids):
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
        cur = conn.execute(
            f"SELECT DISTINCT l2_chunk_id FROM aggregation_coverage WHERE chunk_id IN ({placeholders})",
            batch,
        )
        affected_l2_ids.update(r[0] for r in cur.fetchall())
    unexpected = affected_l2_ids - set(l2_ids_to_release)
    if unexpected:
        raise ValueError(
            f"purge 期間出現新的 L2 覆蓋 {sorted(unexpected)}（doc_id={doc_id}），"
            "其 Chroma 卡片尚未刪除，已整體回滾，請重跑 purge"
        )

    # 2. 釋放整張 L2 的全部 coverage（含其他文件的 chunk）：刪除重建，讓剩餘 chunk
    #    之後從冷啟動重新聚合。
    for batch in _batched(l2_ids_to_release):
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
        conn.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM aggregation_coverage WHERE l2_chunk_id IN ({placeholders})", batch
        )

    # 3. 手動認領名單：不清的話，同 id 的新切塊會被永久排除出自動聚合。
    for batch in _batched(chunk_ids):
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
        conn.execute(
            f"DELETE FROM manual_chunk_claims WHERE chunk_id IN ({placeholders})", batch
        )

    # 4. 建圖暫存佇列：衝突時 chunk_text 不會被更新，不清的話新切塊會拿舊文字抽三元組。
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM graph_image_batch_buffer WHERE parent_doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))

    # 5. 活躍群集（pending／approved／summary_ready／failed）若引用了被清除的
    #    chunk，或以被刪除的 L2 為基底，一律駁回；completed 與 rejected 的歷史列
    #    原樣保留（draft_summary 當歷史）。
    active_statuses = [
        ClusterReviewStatus.PENDING.value,
        ClusterReviewStatus.APPROVED.value,
        ClusterReviewStatus.SUMMARY_READY.value,
        ClusterReviewStatus.FAILED.value,
    ]
    placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(active_statuses))
    rows = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT staged_id, selected_chunk_ids_json, old_l2_id FROM staged_l2_clusters "
        f"WHERE status IN ({placeholders})",
        active_statuses,
    ).fetchall()
    purged_chunk_set = set(chunk_ids)
    released_l2_set = set(l2_ids_to_release)
    to_reject = [
        staged_id for staged_id, chunk_json, old_l2_id in rows
        if (purged_chunk_set & set(_json_loads(chunk_json))) or (old_l2_id in released_l2_set)
    ]
    reason = f"因文件 purge 自動駁回（doc_id={doc_id}）：引用的 chunk 或基底 L2 卡片已被清除"
    now = time.time()
    for batch in _batched(to_reject):
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
        conn.execute(
            f"UPDATE staged_l2_clusters SET status = ?, reviewed_at = ?, last_error = ? "
            f"WHERE staged_id IN ({placeholders})",
            (ClusterReviewStatus.REJECTED.value, now, reason, *batch),
        )

    # 6. 嵌入補送嘗試紀錄：chunk_id 由 doc_id + seq_index 決定，purge 後重新匯入會對應到
    #    同一個 card_id，不清的話新內容會繼承舊的放棄狀態或冷卻時間。
    # @depends-on: modules/processor.py::全文摘要的 chunk_id 為 f"{doc_id}__summary"
    # assumption: 摘要卡片 id 固定為此格式（已核對 processor.py）
    # if broken: 摘要的嘗試紀錄 purge 後殘留，重新匯入的文件可能被誤判為已放棄
    card_ids = chunk_ids + [f"{doc_id}__summary"]
    for batch in _batched(card_ids):
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
        conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM embed_dispatch_attempts WHERE card_id IN ({placeholders})", batch)


def _purge_document_and_chunks_sync(doc_id: str, l2_ids_to_release: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # l2_ids_to_release 為 None 時完全維持原行為（只清三張表）；傳入清單（可為空）
            # 才啟用級聯清理，見 purge_document_cascade。
            if l2_ids_to_release is not None:
                _cascade_release_in_txn(conn, doc_id, l2_ids_to_release)
            # document_chunks.parent_doc_id 雖宣告 ON DELETE CASCADE，但
            # PRAGMA foreign_keys 從未開啟，該宣告不會生效——顯式先刪
            # Chunks 再刪 RawDocument，兩段動作包在同一交易內，不依賴
            # 任何級聯行為。
            cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM document_chunks WHERE parent_doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))
            deleted_chunk_count = cur.rowcount
            # 備註 [Bug 修正]：graph_build_progress 同樣沒有外鍵級聯，過去
            # 從未在這裡清除——文件被 purge 後重新匯入，屬於舊版切塊的
            # chunk_id 進度列會一直殘留，讓 graph_progressed 計數超過新
            # 一輪的 total_chunks（維運主控台看到「30/29」這類超過 100%
            # 的根因）。與上面 document_chunks 同一交易內一併清除。
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM graph_build_progress WHERE doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM raw_documents WHERE doc_id = ?", (doc_id,))
            conn.commit()
            return deleted_chunk_count
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def purge_document_and_chunks(doc_id: str) -> int:
    """
    刪除一份 RawDocument 及其所有 Chunk。呼叫端必須先呼叫

    反過來的話，一旦腳本在兩步之間中斷，document_chunks 列已消失，將

    ⚠️ 這是低階原語，只清 SQLite 的三張表，不清 aggregation_coverage、
    manual_chunk_claims、graph_image_batch_buffer、活躍群集，也不碰 ChromaDB。
    需要完整清理（含引用檢查與向量刪除）時，請呼叫
    modules/graph_doctor.py 的 purge_document_cascade()。
    """
    return await _run_write(_purge_document_and_chunks_sync, doc_id)


def _get_purge_impact_sync(chunk_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    chain_ids: set[str] = set()
    l3_ids: set[str] = set()
    auto_l2_ids: set[str] = set()
    with _sql_lock:
        for batch in _batched(chunk_ids):
            placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
            chain_ids.update(r[0] for r in conn.execute(
                f"SELECT DISTINCT l2_id FROM l2_chain_components "
                f"WHERE component_type = 'chunk' AND component_id IN ({placeholders})", batch,
            ).fetchall())
            l3_ids.update(r[0] for r in conn.execute(
                f"SELECT DISTINCT l3_id FROM l3_concept_sources "
                f"WHERE source_type = 'chunk' AND source_id IN ({placeholders})", batch,
            ).fetchall())
            auto_l2_ids.update(r[0] for r in conn.execute(
                f"SELECT DISTINCT l2_chunk_id FROM aggregation_coverage "
                f"WHERE chunk_id IN ({placeholders})", batch,
            ).fetchall())
    return {
        "manual_l2_chain_ids": sorted(chain_ids),
        "l3_concept_ids": sorted(l3_ids),
        "auto_l2_ids": sorted(auto_l2_ids),
    }


async def get_purge_impact(chunk_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """
    唯讀：回報 purge 這批 chunk 會牽動哪些東西。
    manual_l2_chain_ids／l3_concept_ids：引用了這些 chunk 的手動 L2 鏈與 L3 概念，
    呼叫端應據此阻擋 purge（重新切塊後同 id 會指向不同內容，人工精選內容會被靜默改寫）。
    auto_l2_ids：覆蓋了這些 chunk 的自動 L2 卡片，purge 時應整張刪除重建。
    空清單回傳三個空 list。
    """
    return await _run_read(_get_purge_impact_sync, chunk_ids)


async def purge_document_cascade(doc_id: str, l2_ids_to_release: list[str]) -> int:
    """
    級聯版 purge：同一個 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 交易內，先釋放自動 L2 的 coverage、清手動

    的三個 DELETE。回傳實際刪除的 Chunk 數量。

    呼叫端（graph_doctor.purge_document_cascade）必須先刪除 l2_ids_to_release 對應的
    ChromaDB 卡片再呼叫本函式。若交易內發現還有沒列入的 L2 覆蓋了這些 chunk，

def _find_suspect_relation_edges_sync(chunk_ids: list[str], relation: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    if not chunk_ids:

    with _sql_lock:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(chunk_ids))
        cur = conn.execute(
            f"""
            SELECT DISTINCT ge.edge_id, ge.source_node_id, ge.relation, ge.target_node_id,
                   ge.corroboration_count, ge.confidence, ge.is_tension,
                   sn.canonical_name AS source_name, tn.canonical_name AS target_name
            FROM edge_source_chunks esc
            JOIN graph_edges ge ON ge.edge_id = esc.edge_id
            JOIN graph_nodes sn ON sn.node_id = ge.source_node_id
            JOIN graph_nodes tn ON tn.node_id = ge.target_node_id
            WHERE esc.chunk_id IN ({placeholders}) AND ge.relation = ?
            """,
            (*chunk_ids, relation),
        )
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        rows = [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]
    for r in rows:
        r["is_tension"] = bool(r["is_tension"])
    return rows

def _flag_edge_for_review_sync(edge_id: str, reason: str, flagged_at: float) -> None:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 自行查詢這條邊目前的 verification_tier，不信任呼叫端傳入的判斷——
            # 反駁機制、常態化異常掃描、人工手動標記三個生產者都會經過這裡，
            # 統一在單一寫入點決定 is_established_challenge，任何一個生產者忘記考慮
            # established 狀態都不會漏標。
            cur = conn.execute("SELECT verification_tier FROM graph_edges WHERE edge_id = ?", (edge_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            is_established_challenge = bool(row and row[0] == "established")

            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO edge_review_flags (edge_id, reason, flagged_at, is_established_challenge)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT(edge_id) DO UPDATE SET
                    reason=excluded.reason, flagged_at=excluded.flagged_at,
                    is_established_challenge=excluded.is_established_challenge
                """,
                (edge_id, reason, flagged_at, int(is_established_challenge)),
            )
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise

def _reposition_established_sync(old_edge_id: str | None, new_edge_id: str) -> None:
    """
    原子性重新定位：同一筆交易內先降級舊邊（如果有指定）、再晉升新邊，
    避免「兩個 UPDATE 分開呼叫」中途失敗導致同一時間出現兩條 established 邊
    （或短暫都不是 established）的不一致狀態。
    """
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            if old_edge_id:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE graph_edges SET verification_tier = 'provisional' WHERE edge_id = ?", (old_edge_id,)
                )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE graph_edges SET verification_tier = 'established' WHERE edge_id = ?", (new_edge_id,)
            )
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise

    供 chat_orchestrator._assemble_context_blocks() 使用（Tier 1 整合，見
    對話紀錄範圍界定）：檢查這次撈出來當佐證的 chunk_id 清單，有沒有任何
    一顆支撐到一條「目前是 established、且正在被挑戰」的邊。

    這裡查的不是「Gemini 即將講出的新推論」——那需要結構化三元組萃取，
    目前的回答生成流程沒有這一步（見對話紀錄的範圍缺口說明），要接
    graph_engine.check_established_conflict() 是後續的 Tier 2。這裡查的是粒度較粗
    但零額外 LLM 呼叫成本的替代訊號：「即將餵給它當佐證的既有記憶，剛好
    牽涉到一條正在被質疑的建立真理」，直接用 edge_source_chunks 這張既有
    關聯表反查，不需要新欄位、不需要動 schema。

    只回傳 is_established_challenge=1 的邊，不是所有 established 邊——一條穩定的 established 邊平常
    不需要每次回答都提醒使用者，只有它正被挑戰、審查結果還沒出來時，
    才是該老實告知「這裡有分歧」的時機。人工在 graph_review_console.py
    裁決後 clear_edge_review_flag() 會把列從 edge_review_flags 刪除，
    JOIN 自然就查不到，不需要額外的狀態同步。

    傳入空清單直接回傳 []，不查詢——比照既有 find_suspect_relation_edges
    的防禦寫法。
    """
    return await _run_read(_find_challenged_established_edges_by_chunk_ids_sync, chunk_ids)


def _find_challenged_established_edges_by_node_ids_sync(node_ids: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    if not node_ids:
        return []
    with _sql_lock:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(node_ids))
        cur = conn.execute(
            f"""
            SELECT DISTINCT ge.edge_id, ge.relation, erf.reason,
                   sn.canonical_name AS source_name, tn.canonical_name AS target_name
            FROM graph_edges ge
            JOIN graph_nodes sn ON sn.node_id = ge.source_node_id
            JOIN graph_nodes tn ON tn.node_id = ge.target_node_id
            JOIN edge_review_flags erf ON erf.edge_id = ge.edge_id
            WHERE (ge.source_node_id IN ({placeholders}) OR ge.target_node_id IN ({placeholders}))
              AND ge.verification_tier = 'established' AND erf.is_established_challenge = 1
            """,
            (*node_ids, *node_ids),
        )
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        return [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]

def _get_all_node_source_documents_sync(limit: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        cur = conn.execute(
            """
            SELECT node_id, doc_id, title, source_uri, summary FROM (
                SELECT ge.source_node_id AS node_id, rd.doc_id, rd.title, rd.source_uri,
                       summary_chunk.text AS summary
                FROM edge_source_chunks esc
                JOIN graph_edges ge ON ge.edge_id = esc.edge_id
                JOIN document_chunks dc ON dc.chunk_id = esc.chunk_id
                JOIN raw_documents rd ON rd.doc_id = dc.parent_doc_id
                LEFT JOIN document_chunks summary_chunk
                    ON summary_chunk.parent_doc_id = rd.doc_id AND summary_chunk.source_type = 'summary'
                UNION
                SELECT ge.target_node_id AS node_id, rd.doc_id, rd.title, rd.source_uri,
                       summary_chunk.text AS summary
                FROM edge_source_chunks esc
                JOIN graph_edges ge ON ge.edge_id = esc.edge_id
                JOIN document_chunks dc ON dc.chunk_id = esc.chunk_id
                JOIN raw_documents rd ON rd.doc_id = dc.parent_doc_id
                LEFT JOIN document_chunks summary_chunk
                    ON summary_chunk.parent_doc_id = rd.doc_id AND summary_chunk.source_type = 'summary'
            )
            LIMIT ?
            """,
            (limit,),
        )
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        return [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]


async def get_all_node_source_documents(*, limit: int = 100000) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    另一條邊的 target_node_id，兩邊都要涵蓋才不會漏掉來源文件。同一個

    return await _run_read(_get_all_node_source_documents_sync, limit)


def _get_edge_source_chunk_ids_sync(edge_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    result: dict[str, list[str]] = {eid: [] for eid in edge_ids}
    if not edge_ids:
        return result
    with _sql_lock:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(edge_ids))
        cur = conn.execute(
            f"SELECT edge_id, chunk_id FROM edge_source_chunks WHERE edge_id IN ({placeholders})",
            edge_ids,
        )
        for edge_id, chunk_id in cur.fetchall():
            result[edge_id].append(chunk_id)
    return result

def _get_edges_by_chunk_ids_sync(chunk_ids: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    if not chunk_ids:
        return result
    with _sql_lock:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(chunk_ids))
        cur = conn.execute(
            f"""
            SELECT ge.*, sn.canonical_name AS source_name, tn.canonical_name AS target_name,
                   esc.chunk_id AS matched_chunk_id
            FROM edge_source_chunks esc
            JOIN graph_edges ge ON ge.edge_id = esc.edge_id
            JOIN graph_nodes sn ON sn.node_id = ge.source_node_id
            JOIN graph_nodes tn ON tn.node_id = ge.target_node_id
            WHERE esc.chunk_id IN ({placeholders})
            """,
            chunk_ids,
        )
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        result = [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]
    for r in result:
        r["is_tension"] = bool(r["is_tension"])
    return result

def _get_chunk_ids_in_active_staged_clusters_sync(chunk_ids: list[str]) -> set[str]:
    if not chunk_ids:
        return set()
    wanted = set(chunk_ids)
    # 備註 [α 閘門]：summary_ready（草稿待審）與 failed（待人工處置）的 chunk 同樣
    # 仍在等人處理，必須一併排除，否則會被重複提案。
    active_statuses = [
        ClusterReviewStatus.PENDING.value,
        ClusterReviewStatus.APPROVED.value,
        ClusterReviewStatus.SUMMARY_READY.value,
        ClusterReviewStatus.FAILED.value,
    ]
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(active_statuses))
        cur = conn.execute(
            f"SELECT selected_chunk_ids_json FROM staged_l2_clusters WHERE status IN ({placeholders})",
            active_statuses,
        )
        rows = cur.fetchall()
    in_review: set[str] = set()
    for (raw,) in rows:
        in_review |= wanted & set(_json_loads(raw))
    return in_review


async def get_chunk_ids_in_active_staged_clusters(chunk_ids: list[str]) -> set[str]:
    """
    回傳候選 chunk_id 中，已在「待審、待生成、草稿待審、生成失敗待處置」
    （pending／approved／summary_ready／failed）群集裡的子集，供
    run_aggregation_sweep 排除，避免同一批 chunk 在審查與生成期間每輪都
    被重複提案。

    刻意不含 rejected／completed：駁回代表「這次先不要」，chunk 下輪應可
    重新被提案；completed 的 chunk 已由 aggregation_coverage 排除。
    """
    return await _run_read(_get_chunk_ids_in_active_staged_clusters_sync, chunk_ids)



def _update_staged_cluster_decision_sync(
    staged_id: str,
    status: str,
    selected_chunk_ids_json: str | None,
    reviewed_at: float,
    expected_status: str,
) -> bool:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註 [端到端審查修正]：加上 AND status = ? 狀態守衛，由 SQL 原子判斷。
            # 先前無條件 UPDATE，過期頁面可把 completed 的群集拉回 approved，
            # 讓 run_approved_l2_sweep 用同批 chunk 重新生成並覆寫卡片；對不存在的
            # staged_id 也是 0 列卻靜默成功。rowcount 是唯一可信的成敗訊號。
            if selected_chunk_ids_json is not None:
                cur = conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE staged_l2_clusters SET status = ?, selected_chunk_ids_json = ?, reviewed_at = ? "
                    "WHERE staged_id = ? AND status = ?",
                    (status, selected_chunk_ids_json, reviewed_at, staged_id, expected_status),
                )
            else:
                cur = conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE staged_l2_clusters SET status = ?, reviewed_at = ? "
                    "WHERE staged_id = ? AND status = ?",
                    (status, reviewed_at, staged_id, expected_status),
                )
            updated = cur.rowcount == 1
            conn.commit()
            return updated
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def update_staged_cluster_decision(
    *, staged_id: str, status: ClusterReviewStatus, selected_chunk_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    expected_status: ClusterReviewStatus = ClusterReviewStatus.PENDING,
) -> bool:
    """
    更新審查決策（approved/rejected），支援審查者手動增修切塊清單。
    status 收 Enum 型別、於此邊界轉 .value——比照 update_stage(stage: Stage)
    的既有慣例，呼叫端不需要、也不應該自己組字串。

    只有目前狀態等於 expected_status（預設 pending）的群集才能被更新。
    回傳 True 代表這次真的更新了一列；False 代表查無此 staged_id，或它
    目前不是 expected_status。呼叫端必須檢查回傳值，不可當成無條件成功。
    α 閘門新增的用法：丟棄草稿傳 expected_status=SUMMARY_READY，
    駁回失敗群集傳 expected_status=FAILED。
    """
    chunk_json = _json_dumps(selected_chunk_ids) if selected_chunk_ids is not None else None
    return await _run_write(
        _update_staged_cluster_decision_sync,
        staged_id, status.value, chunk_json, time.time(), expected_status.value,
    )

def _save_staged_cluster_draft_sync(
    staged_id: str, draft_summary: str, base_doc: str | None,
    from_status: str, to_status: str,
) -> bool:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註 [α 閘門]：old_l2_doc 在此被覆寫成「生成草稿時實際使用的基底」，
            # 不再是提案當下的快照。接受草稿時靠它與目前 Chroma 文本比對，偵測
            # 審查期間同一張 L2 是否已被別的群集更新（lost update 防護）。
            # 成功生成即清掉先前失敗留下的 last_error；attempt_count 不歸零，

                "UPDATE staged_l2_clusters SET draft_summary = ?, old_l2_doc = ?, "
                "status = ?, last_error = NULL WHERE staged_id = ? AND status = ?",
                (draft_summary, base_doc, to_status, staged_id, from_status),
            )
            updated = cur.rowcount == 1
            conn.commit()
            return updated
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise

def _record_staged_cluster_failure_sync(
    staged_id: str, error: str, max_attempts: int, approved: str, failed: str
) -> str | None:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # SQLite 的 UPDATE 右側運算式一律讀取更新前的列值，所以
            # attempt_count + 1 >= ? 用的是舊值，與同一句的 attempt_count + 1 一致。
            cur = conn.execute(
                "UPDATE staged_l2_clusters SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error = ?, "
                "status = CASE WHEN attempt_count + 1 >= ? THEN ? ELSE status END "
                "WHERE staged_id = ? AND status = ?",
                (error, max_attempts, failed, staged_id, approved),
            )
            if cur.rowcount != 1:
                conn.commit()
                return None
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM staged_l2_clusters WHERE staged_id = ?", (staged_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            conn.commit()
            return row[0]
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def record_staged_cluster_failure(
    *, staged_id: str, error: str, max_attempts: int
) -> str | None:
    """
    記錄一次群集專屬的草稿生成失敗：attempt_count + 1、寫入 last_error，
    達到 max_attempts 時同一交易內把 approved 轉為 failed。回傳更新後的
    status；None 代表該群集已不是 approved（查無或被並行改動）。

    只應為「群集專屬」的失敗呼叫。額度耗盡、速率限制這類系統性失敗不屬於
    某個群集的錯，計入會讓額度用盡當天所有群集被打進 failed。
    """
    return await _run_write(
        _record_staged_cluster_failure_sync, staged_id, error, max_attempts,
        ClusterReviewStatus.APPROVED.value, ClusterReviewStatus.FAILED.value,
    )

def _get_missing_graph_chunks_sync(
    doc_id: str, exclude_dispatched_since: float | None
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        if exclude_dispatched_since is None:
            cur = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT * FROM document_chunks
                WHERE parent_doc_id = ?
                  AND chunk_id NOT IN (
                      SELECT chunk_id FROM graph_build_progress WHERE doc_id = ?
                  )
                """,
                (doc_id, doc_id),
            )
        else:
            # 備註 [P0 修復]：多一個 NOT IN 子查詢，排除「最近一次派發
            # 時間落在冷卻窗口內」的 chunk——與上面 graph_build_progress
            # 的排除條件是互補關係，不是取代：前者代表「尚未完成」，這裡
            # 代表「雖未完成，但很可能還在佇列裡排隊，不該現在就重派」。
            cur = conn.execute(
                """
                SELECT * FROM document_chunks
                WHERE parent_doc_id = ?
                  AND chunk_id NOT IN (
                      SELECT chunk_id FROM graph_build_progress WHERE doc_id = ?
                  )
                  AND chunk_id NOT IN (
                      SELECT chunk_id FROM graph_dispatch_attempts WHERE dispatched_at >= ?
                  )
                """,
                (doc_id, doc_id, exclude_dispatched_since),
            )
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        return [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]


async def get_missing_graph_chunks(
    doc_id: str, *, exclude_dispatched_since: float | None = None
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    決策總帳條目十九的最終落地版本。回傳該文件已持久化、但尚未出現在
    graph_build_progress 的一般 Chunk 完整內容，可直接重建 Chunk 物件
    重新扇出，不需要重跑 Two-Pass Pipeline、不重新呼叫 LLM。

    exclude_dispatched_since（P0 修復，見「佇列背壓自我複製」事故）：
    選配的冷卻窗口下限時間戳。非 None 時，額外排除「最近一次被
    run_recovery_sweep 派發的時間 >= 此值」的 chunk，避免同一顆還在
    佇列排隊、尚未真正處理完成的 chunk 被下一輪巡檢誤判為缺失而重複
    派發。預設 None 維持原行為（不篩選）——目前唯一呼叫端是
    run_recovery_sweep，其餘假設不存在的呼叫端若有，行為不受影響。
    """
    return await _run_read(_get_missing_graph_chunks_sync, doc_id, exclude_dispatched_since)


def _get_stalled_processed_documents_sync(
    limit: int, exclude_active_since: float | None
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    conditions = ["pipeline_stage = 'processed'", "total_chunks IS NOT NULL"]
    params: list[Any] = []
    if exclude_active_since is not None:
        # @depends-on: modules/graph_engine.py::graph_image_batch_buffer 的 arrived_at 在每顆 chunk
        #   抵達時刷新、consumed_at 在整批成功後寫入
        # assumption: 文件仍在被某個行程消化時，buffer 內必有一筆 arrived_at／consumed_at 落在窗口內
        # if broken: 守衛認不出「正在處理中」的文件，scheduler 行程的 recovery 會重新對同一批 buffer
        #   重複呼叫 LLM（跨行程重複萃取）
        conditions.append("(chunked_at IS NULL OR chunked_at < ?)")
        conditions.append(
            "doc_id NOT IN ("
            "  SELECT parent_doc_id FROM graph_image_batch_buffer "
            "  WHERE arrived_at >= ? OR (consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at >= ?))"
        )
        params.extend([exclude_active_since] * 3)
    sql = (
        "SELECT doc_id, total_chunks, done_count FROM ("
        "  SELECT doc_id, total_chunks,"
        "         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graph_build_progress"
        "          WHERE doc_id = raw_documents.doc_id) AS done_count"
        "  FROM raw_documents WHERE " + " AND ".join(conditions) +
        ") WHERE done_count < total_chunks LIMIT ?"
    )
    params.append(limit)
    with _sql_lock:
        cur = conn.execute(sql, params)
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        return [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]

    只負責「哪些文件需要處理」，不碰 chunk_id 命名慣例等業務知識。

    exclude_active_since（跨行程重複萃取修正）：非 None 時，排除切塊完成時間
    或暫存佇列任何一筆 arrived_at／consumed_at 晚於此時間戳的文件，代表它
    可能仍被另一個行程消化中。預設 None 維持原行為（admin /status 沿用）。
    """
    return await _run_read(_get_stalled_processed_documents_sync, limit, exclude_active_since)

    older_than: float, limit: int, exclude_requeued_since: float | None, max_attempts: int | None
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    conditions = ["pipeline_stage = 'raw_ingested'", "fetched_at < ?"]
    params: list[Any] = [older_than]
    if exclude_requeued_since is not None:
        # 備註 [決策總帳條目四十延伸修正]：與 fetched_at 互補——夠舊，但很可能
        # 還在 PROCESSOR 裡處理中或剛失敗不久，不該現在又重派一次。
        conditions.append(
            "doc_id NOT IN (SELECT doc_id FROM intake_requeue_attempts WHERE requeued_at >= ?)"
        )
        params.append(exclude_requeued_since)
    if max_attempts is not None:
        conditions.append(
            "doc_id NOT IN (SELECT doc_id FROM intake_requeue_attempts WHERE attempt_count >= ?)"
        )
        params.append(max_attempts)
    sql = "SELECT * FROM raw_documents WHERE " + " AND ".join(conditions) + " LIMIT ?"
    params.append(limit)
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        cur = conn.execute(sql, params)
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        rows = [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]
    for r in rows:
        r["extra"] = _json_loads(r.pop("extra_json"))
        r["asset_ids"] = _json_loads(r.pop("asset_ids_json"))
    return rows

) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    決策總帳條目二十四附帶：intake.py publish() 被拒絕後的殘餘停滯文件。
    older_than 由呼叫端傳入 time.time() - threshold_seconds。

def _record_dispatch_attempts_sync(chunk_ids: list[str], dispatched_at: float) -> None:
    conn = _get_connection()
    if not chunk_ids:
        return
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註：ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE 覆蓋為最新派發時間——同一顆
            # chunk 若在冷卻窗口過後又被合法地重新派發，這裡要反映的是
            # 「最近一次」而非累積歷史，語意與 aggregation_coverage 的
            # INSERT OR REPLACE 慣例一致。
            conn.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO graph_dispatch_attempts (chunk_id, dispatched_at) VALUES (?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET dispatched_at = excluded.dispatched_at",
                [(cid, dispatched_at) for cid in chunk_ids],
            )
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise

    扇出路徑對每顆 chunk 只會扇出一次，不存在重複派發問題，不需要記錄。
    """
    await _run_write(_record_dispatch_attempts_sync, chunk_ids, dispatched_at)

def _get_pending_summaries_sync(
    limit: int,
    exclude_dispatched_since: float | None,
    chunked_before: float | None,
    max_attempts: int | None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    # @depends-on: modules/processor.py::全文摘要的 chunk_id 為 f"{doc_id}__summary"
    # assumption: 嘗試紀錄表以此格式作為 card_id
    # if broken: 冷卻與嘗試上限的排除條件對不上，每輪重送同一批摘要
    conditions = ["pending_summary IS NOT NULL"]
    params: list[Any] = []
    if chunked_before is not None:
        # 寬限期：摘要才剛送進 EMBEDDER 佇列、尚未落地的文件不重送。chunked_at 為 NULL
        # 代表尚未完成切塊（Pass1 與 finalize 之間崩潰），由 stalled_intake 負責，不在此重送。
        conditions.append("chunked_at IS NOT NULL AND chunked_at < ?")
        params.append(chunked_before)
    if exclude_dispatched_since is not None:
        conditions.append(
            "(doc_id || '__summary') NOT IN ("
            "  SELECT card_id FROM embed_dispatch_attempts WHERE dispatched_at >= ?)"
        )
        params.append(exclude_dispatched_since)
    if max_attempts is not None:
        conditions.append(
            "(doc_id || '__summary') NOT IN ("
            "  SELECT card_id FROM embed_dispatch_attempts WHERE attempt_count >= ?)"
        )
        params.append(max_attempts)
    sql = (
        "SELECT doc_id, pending_summary, source_credibility, evidence_polarity "
        "FROM raw_documents WHERE " + " AND ".join(conditions) + " LIMIT ?"
    )
    params.append(limit)
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        cur = conn.execute(sql, params)
        cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
        return [dict(zip(cols, r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]

# ── graph_image_batch_buffer（滑動視窗暫存佇列，唯一真相來源） ──────


def _buffer_chunk_for_batching_sync(
    chunk_id: str, parent_doc_id: str, chunk_text: str, arrived_at: float
) -> None:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註：改用條件式 UPSERT，而非無條件覆寫。arrived_at 一律更新，
            # 用來打破「無法分辨 Worker 有沒有真的重新走到這一行」的觀測盲區；
            # 但 consumed_at 只有在 graph_build_progress 裡查無終態紀錄時
            # （代表這顆還沒做完，含「已消費但終態紀錄遺失」的孤兒切塊）才重置為
            # NULL 拉回可消費狀態。若已有終態紀錄（真的做完了），維持原值不動，
            # 避免誤把已完成的 chunk 打回佇列、重複送一次大模型。
            conn.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO graph_image_batch_buffer
                    (chunk_id, parent_doc_id, chunk_text, arrived_at, consumed_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL)
                ON CONFLICT(chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET
                    chunk_text = excluded.chunk_text,
                    arrived_at = excluded.arrived_at,
                    consumed_at = CASE
                        WHEN EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM graph_build_progress
                            WHERE doc_id = excluded.parent_doc_id
                              AND chunk_id = excluded.chunk_id
                        )
                        THEN graph_image_batch_buffer.consumed_at
                        ELSE NULL
                    END
                """,
                (chunk_id, parent_doc_id, chunk_text, arrived_at),
            )
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def buffer_chunk_for_batching(
    *, chunk_id: str, parent_doc_id: str, chunk_text: str, arrived_at: float
) -> None:
    """graph_engine.py 滑動視窗封裝的暫存寫入。Dispatcher 重複派發同一顆
    chunk 時一律刷新 arrived_at（供觀測是否真的重新處理過）；若該 chunk
    尚未出現在 graph_build_progress，一併把 consumed_at 重置為 NULL 拉回
    可消費狀態（修復消費與終態紀錄非原子導致的孤兒切塊）；已有終態紀錄的
    chunk 則不受影響。"""
    await _run_write(
        _buffer_chunk_for_batching_sync, chunk_id, parent_doc_id, chunk_text, arrived_at
    )

def _reject_classification_candidate_sync(node_id: str) -> str:
    """
    見對話紀錄「新發現 4」：與 confirm 對稱的狀態守衛。原本
    _mark_classification_candidate_status_sync 對任意 node_id 無條件
    UPDATE——查無此列時影響 0 列、靜默假裝成功；對已 confirmed 的節點
    誤呼叫 reject 時，會產生「graph_nodes.bfo_type 已分類、sidecar 卻
    標記 rejected」的自我矛盾狀態，違反本函式 docstring 自己的承諾。
    這裡改為顯式檢查存在性與 pending 狀態後才寫入，回傳明確結果碼。

    備註 [S6 死代碼清理]：原本的 _mark_classification_candidate_status_sync
    是本檔案私有函式，僅被 confirm_classification_candidate()（前次已
    改為內聯 _confirm_classification_candidate_sync）與這裡兩處呼叫；
    兩處都已改為各自內聯查詢＋更新，故該函式移除，不留無主程式碼。
    """
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM graph_node_classification_candidates WHERE node_id = ?",
                (node_id,),
            )
            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row is None:
                conn.rollback()
                return "not_found"
            if row[0] != "pending":
                conn.rollback()
                return f"invalid_status:{row[0]}"

            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE graph_node_classification_candidates SET status = 'rejected' "
                "WHERE node_id = ?",
                (node_id,),
            )
            conn.commit()
            return "rejected"
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


def _confirm_classification_candidate_sync(node_id: str, bfo_type: str, domain: str) -> str:
    """
    見對話紀錄「新發現 1+2」：原本兩段獨立的 _run_write 呼叫
    （先寫 graph_nodes，再標記 sidecar confirmed）之間若中途失敗，
    會留下 bfo_type 已寫入、但 status 永遠卡在 pending 的幽靈審查列；
    且原實作完全沒檢查 node_id 是否真的存在於複核佇列且為 pending，
    等於任何真實存在的 node_id 都能被拿來繞過複核直接改寫 graph_nodes。
    這裡把「檢查存在與狀態」「寫回 graph_nodes」「標記 confirmed」三步
    包進單一 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 交易，回傳明確結果碼供呼叫端分辨。
    """
    assert bfo_type in ("IC", "SDC", "OCC"), (
        f"confirm_classification_candidate 收到非法 bfo_type={bfo_type!r}，"
        f"node_id={node_id}——UNCERTAIN 或其他值不得直接寫入 graph_nodes"
    )
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            cur = conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM graph_node_classification_candidates WHERE node_id = ?",
                (node_id,),
            )
            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row is None:
                conn.rollback()
                return "not_found"
            if row[0] != "pending":
                conn.rollback()
                return f"invalid_status:{row[0]}"

            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE graph_nodes SET bfo_type = ?, domain = ? WHERE node_id = ?",
                (bfo_type, domain, node_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE graph_node_classification_candidates SET status = 'confirmed' "
                "WHERE node_id = ?",
                (node_id,),
            )
            conn.commit()
            return "confirmed"
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def confirm_classification_candidate(node_id: str, bfo_type: str, domain: str) -> str:
    """
    H 節：人工複核複核佇列裡的一筆候選後確認。bfo_type/domain 由呼叫端
    顯式傳入，不是無條件照抄 suggested_bfo_type/suggested_domain——人工
    複核可能修正 LLM 的建議值（例如原本 UNCERTAIN，人工判斷後其實是
    SDC）。回傳 "confirmed"／"not_found"／"invalid_status:<status>"，
    取代原本永遠回傳 None 的無條件成功假象，供呼叫端（UI）明確分辨
    三種結果並各自給出正確提示。sidecar 列不刪除，標記
    status='confirmed' 保留歷史軌跡。
    """
    return await _run_write(_confirm_classification_candidate_sync, node_id, bfo_type, domain)


async def reject_classification_candidate(node_id: str) -> str:
    """
    H 節：人工駁回。graph_nodes.bfo_type 維持 NULL——不代表「已分類為
    無法分類」，而是「維持未分類，留給未來人工或更好的分類器重新處理」。
    sidecar 列標記 status='rejected'。

    回傳 "rejected"／"not_found"／"invalid_status:<status>"（新發現 4
    修正），取代原本永遠回傳 None 的無條件成功假象——對查無此列、或
    已是 confirmed/merged 等非 pending 狀態的節點呼叫，會被安全拒絕，
    不再產生 graph_nodes 已分類、sidecar 卻標記 rejected 的矛盾狀態。
    """
    return await _run_write(_reject_classification_candidate_sync, node_id)

    """_resolve_entity() 第2層命中高信心區間但不直接合併時呼叫。

    呼叫端（graph_engine._resolve_entity）顯式傳遞。這不是權威溯源
    欄位（權威溯源仍是 edge_source_chunks），純供人工複核時查看原文
    語境；existing_node_id 那一側的語境會隨時間變動，不落地存，複核
    時應即時呼叫 get_edges_by_node_id(existing_node_id) 查詢最新狀態。

    context_similarity 是可選的關係語境相似度分數，計算失敗或既有節點
    尚無任何邊可比對時皆合法為 None，純粹是複核介面的第二個參考分數，
    不參與任何自動決策。
    """
    await _run_write(
        _insert_entity_merge_candidate_sync,
        new_node_id,
        existing_node_id,
        distance,
        created_at,
        source_chunk_id,
        context_similarity,
    )

def _confirm_and_merge_node_sync(new_node_id: str, existing_node_id: str, k: float) -> str:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            # 備註 [新發現 5 修正，見對話紀錄]：原本完全沒讀取
            # entity_merge_candidates.status，只檢查兩個 node_id 是否
            # 還存在——代表一筆已被人工 reject_merge_candidate() 駁回的
            # 候選，只要兩節點仍存在，重複呼叫本函式依然會執行合併，
            # 完全繞過人工駁回決策。這裡先查候選本身的狀態，非 pending
            # 一律安全拒絕、不觸碰任何節點或邊。
            #
            # 附帶修正一個潛藏問題：若候選早已是 'merged'（new_node_id
            # 已在更早一次呼叫中被刪除），原本的邏輯順序會先跑下面的
            # COUNT(*) 檢查、發現 new_node_id 不存在、誤判成"stale"並
            # 覆寫掉本來正確的 'merged' 狀態。現在狀態檢查提前，
            # 'merged'/'rejected'/'stale' 都會在此原樣回傳，不會被覆寫。
            cur = conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM entity_merge_candidates "
                "WHERE new_node_id = ? AND existing_node_id = ?",
                (new_node_id, existing_node_id),
            )
            candidate_row = cur.fetchone()
            if candidate_row is None:
                conn.rollback()
                return "not_found"
            if candidate_row[0] != "pending":
                conn.rollback()
                return candidate_row[0]

            cur = conn.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM graph_nodes WHERE node_id IN (?, ?)",
                (new_node_id, existing_node_id),
            )
            if cur.fetchone()[0] != 2:
                # 備註：confirm 當下才檢查兩個 node_id 是否都還存在——等待
                # 期間若 new_node_id 已被更早的另一筆合併吃掉，視為過期
                # 候選，標記 stale 並優雅返回，不拋錯。
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE entity_merge_candidates SET status = 'stale' "
                    "WHERE new_node_id = ? AND existing_node_id = ?",
                    (new_node_id, existing_node_id),
                )
                conn.commit()
                return "stale"

            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE OR IGNORE graph_edges SET source_node_id = ? WHERE source_node_id = ?",
                (existing_node_id, new_node_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE OR IGNORE graph_edges SET target_node_id = ? WHERE target_node_id = ?",
                (existing_node_id, new_node_id),
            )
            # 備註：UPDATE OR IGNORE 無法處理轉接後違反 UNIQUE(source_node_id,
            # relation, target_node_id) 的邊（existing_node_id 對同一個
            # 第三節點已有相同關係）——這種邊會被 IGNORE 悄悄跳過，殘留
            # 指向即將被刪除的 new_node_id。在刪除這些殘留邊前，必須先把
            # 它們的佐證 chunk 轉移進那條「早已存在、轉接時撞上」的存活
            # 邊——原本註解「不遺失資訊」只涵蓋關係本身沒消失，沒涵蓋
            # 佐證證據，這裡補上轉移，並依實際轉移後的佐證數重算存活邊
            # 的 confidence（同 record_edge_evidence()/sweep_orphaned_edges()
            # 的對數加成公式，不另開一套）。
            orphaned_edges = conn.execute(
                "SELECT edge_id, source_node_id, relation, target_node_id "
                "FROM graph_edges WHERE source_node_id = ? OR target_node_id = ?",
                (new_node_id, new_node_id),
            ).fetchall()
            for edge_id, src, relation, tgt in orphaned_edges:
                survivor_src = existing_node_id if src == new_node_id else src
                survivor_tgt = existing_node_id if tgt == new_node_id else tgt
                survivor = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT edge_id, base_confidence FROM graph_edges "
                    "WHERE source_node_id = ? AND relation = ? AND target_node_id = ?",
                    (survivor_src, relation, survivor_tgt),
                ).fetchone()
                if survivor is not None:
                    survivor_edge_id, base_confidence = survivor
                    conn.execute(
                        "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO edge_source_chunks (edge_id, chunk_id) "
                        "SELECT ?, chunk_id FROM edge_source_chunks WHERE edge_id = ?",
                        (survivor_edge_id, edge_id),
                    )
                    new_count = conn.execute(
                        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edge_source_chunks WHERE edge_id = ?",
                        (survivor_edge_id,),
                    ).fetchone()[0]
                    new_confidence = min(base_confidence * (1 + math.log(1 + new_count) * k), 1.0)
                    conn.execute(
                        "UPDATE graph_edges SET corroboration_count = ?, confidence = ? "
                        "WHERE edge_id = ?",
                        (new_count, new_confidence, survivor_edge_id),
                    )
                conn.execute("DELETE FROM edge_source_chunks WHERE edge_id = ?", (edge_id,))
            conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM graph_edges WHERE source_node_id = ? OR target_node_id = ?",
                (new_node_id, new_node_id),
            )

            # 備註：new_node_id 若曾被人工掛載進手動 L2 鏈
            # （l2_chain_components.component_type='node'，見
            # save_l2_bundle），節點刪除前必須把掛載參照轉點到
            # existing_node_id，否則 get_l2_chain_bundle() 的 Tolerant
            # Read 會在查無節點時靜默剔除，人工精選內容會不留痕跡地
            # 消失。UPDATE OR IGNORE：若該 L2 鏈已掛載過 existing_node_id
            # （PRIMARY KEY 衝突），代表這筆參照本來就是多餘重複，被
            # 忽略後仍留在原表指向 new_node_id，下面 DELETE 清掉這種
            # 殘留重複列。
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE OR IGNORE l2_chain_components SET component_id = ? "
                "WHERE component_type = 'node' AND component_id = ?",
                (existing_node_id, new_node_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM l2_chain_components WHERE component_type = 'node' AND component_id = ?",
                (new_node_id,),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE OR IGNORE l3_concept_sources SET source_id = ? "
                "WHERE source_type = 'node' AND source_id = ?",
                (existing_node_id, new_node_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM l3_concept_sources WHERE source_type = 'node' AND source_id = ?",
                (new_node_id,),
            )

            # 備註 [新發現 3，見對話紀錄]：new_node_id 若在合併前已進入
            # BFO 分類複核佇列（graph_node_classification_candidates 以
            # node_id 為 PRIMARY KEY），節點刪除後該列會變成指向不存在
            # 節點的孤兒列——load_candidates_data() 用 INNER JOIN 會靜默
            # 排除它，永久卡在表裡且不再被任何人看到或處理。不轉移給
            # existing_node_id：兩者合併前是分類器各自獨立判斷過的不同
            # 原始提及，existing_node_id 若已有自己的候選/分類結果，
            # 直接覆蓋會遺失既有判斷；existing_node_id 若尚未分類過，
            # 讓它自然被 get_unclassified_graph_nodes() 排入下一輪分類
            # 即可，不需要繼承一筆可能已經過時的建議。故直接刪除，
            # 不轉移。
            conn.execute(
                "DELETE FROM graph_node_classification_candidates WHERE node_id = ?",
                (new_node_id,),
            )

            conn.execute("DELETE FROM graph_nodes WHERE node_id = ?", (new_node_id,))
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE entity_merge_candidates SET status = 'merged' "
                "WHERE new_node_id = ? AND existing_node_id = ?",
                (new_node_id, existing_node_id),
            )
            conn.commit()
            return "merged"
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def confirm_and_merge_node(
    *, new_node_id: str, existing_node_id: str, k: float = 0.2
) -> str:
    """人工 confirm 後呼叫，原子性完成邊轉接、佐證轉移與 L2 掛載轉點。

    回傳值（新發現 5 修正，新增狀態守衛後的完整集合）：
      "merged"     — 本次真的完成合併
      "stale"      — 候選為 pending，但兩節點之一已不存在（多半是被
                      更早的另一筆合併吃掉）
      "rejected"   — 候選已被人工 reject_merge_candidate() 駁回，本次
                      呼叫被安全拒絕，不執行任何寫入
      "not_found"  — entity_merge_candidates 查無這對節點的候選紀錄

    冪等：對已是 stale/merged/rejected 的候選重複呼叫，皆原樣回傳現有
    狀態，不會重複轉接、不會覆寫既有判斷。

    k 須與 record_edge_evidence()/sweep_orphaned_edges() 使用同一個
    對數加成係數，三者共用同一套 confidence 語意。

    ⚠️ S3 風險揭露：本次修正把回傳值集合從 {"merged","stale"} 擴增為
    {"merged","stale","rejected","not_found"}。本次提供的檔案範圍內
    找不到這支函式的呼叫端（推測是未提供的合併候選審查 UI），無法
    確認外部呼叫端是否只判斷 result == "merged" 決定成功與否（此情況
    不受影響），或是否對非 "merged"/"stale" 的分支做了會 assert 失敗
    的窮舉判斷（此情況需要呼叫端同步修改）。合併前請自行搜尋全專案
    確認呼叫端的判斷邏輯。
    """
    return await _run_write(_confirm_and_merge_node_sync, new_node_id, existing_node_id, k)

def _get_lineage_sync(round_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """從 round_id 沿 parent_round_id 往回走到樹根，回傳 root -> round_id
    的順序（inclusive）。鏈長不是效能瓶頸，用 Python 迴圈換可讀性與好除錯。"""
    conn = _get_connection()
    chain: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    current_id: str | None = round_id
    with _sql_lock:
        while current_id is not None:
            cur = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM rounds WHERE round_id = ?", (current_id,))
            row = cur.fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"round 鏈斷裂：round_id={current_id} 在 rounds 表查無紀錄"
                    "（資料完整性異常，不應該悄悄中斷鏈）"
                )
            cols = [d[0] for d in cur.description]
            record = dict(zip(cols, row))
            chain.append(record)
            current_id = record["parent_round_id"]
    chain.reverse()
    return chain


async def get_lineage(round_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """回傳 round_id 的完整祖先鏈，每筆已把 JSON 欄位解回 Python 物件。
    exploration_engine.py 的 visited/confirmed 推導都建立在這個函式上。"""
    rows = await _run_read(_get_lineage_sync, round_id)
    for r in rows:

        r["seed_chunk_ids"] = _json_loads(r["seed_chunk_ids"])
        r["candidates_shown"] = _json_loads(r["candidates_shown"])
        r["confirmed_node_ids"] = _json_loads(r["confirmed_node_ids"])
        r["confirmed_chunk_ids"] = _json_loads(r["confirmed_chunk_ids"])
    return rows

def _create_l3_concept_sync(
    l3_id: str,
    text: str,
    created_at: float,
    sources: list[tuple[str, str]],
    provenance: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> bool:
    if not sources:
        raise ValueError(f"create_l3_concept 失敗:l3_id={l3_id} 未提供任何來源，L3 必須可回溯")
    deduped_sources = list(dict.fromkeys((stype, sid) for stype, sid in sources))
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = conn.execute("SELECT text FROM l3_concepts WHERE l3_id = ?", (l3_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is not None:
                if row[0] != text:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"create_l3_concept 失敗:l3_id={l3_id} 已存在但文字不同，拒絕靜默覆蓋"
                    )
                conn.rollback()
                return False  # 相同概念已存在：不追加來源、不覆寫出處，呼叫端可安全重做向量寫入

            for source_type, source_id in deduped_sources:
                if source_type == "l2_chain":
                    cur = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM l2_chains WHERE l2_id = ?", (source_id,))
                elif source_type == "chunk":
                    cur = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM document_chunks WHERE chunk_id = ?", (source_id,))
                elif source_type == "node":
                    cur = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM graph_nodes WHERE node_id = ?", (source_id,))
                else:
                    raise ValueError(f"create_l3_concept 失敗:未知的 source_type={source_type!r}")
                if cur.fetchone() is None:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"create_l3_concept 失敗:來源 ({source_type}, {source_id}) 查無對應紀錄"
                    )

            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO l3_concepts (l3_id, text, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (l3_id, text, created_at),
            )
            conn.executemany(
                "INSERT INTO l3_concept_sources (l3_id, source_type, source_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                [(l3_id, stype, sid) for stype, sid in deduped_sources],
            )
            if provenance:
                conn.execute(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO l3_hypotheses_provenance
                        (l3_id, pattern_shape, support, confidence, confirmations,
                         conflicts, reviewed_by, review_notes, status, created_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    """,
                    (
                        l3_id,
                        provenance["pattern_shape"],
                        provenance["support"],
                        provenance["confidence"],
                        provenance["confirmations"],
                        provenance["conflicts"],
                        provenance["reviewed_by"],
                        provenance.get("review_notes", ""),
                        provenance["status"],
                        created_at,
                    ),
                )
            conn.commit()
            return True
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise

def _update_l3_hypothesis_dynamic_stats_sync(
    l3_id: str,
    current_support: int,
    current_confirmations: int,
    current_conflicts: int,
    current_confidence: float | None,
    needs_review: bool,
    updated_at: float,
    endpoint_node_ids: list[str],
    active_value: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM l3_hypotheses_provenance WHERE l3_id = ?", (l3_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None or row[0] != active_value:
                conn.rollback()
                return {"updated": False, "nodes_added": 0, "nodes_removed": 0}

            conn.execute(
                """
                UPDATE l3_hypotheses_provenance
                SET current_support = ?,
                    current_confirmations = ?,
                    current_conflicts = ?,
                    current_confidence = ?,
                    stats_updated_at = ?,
                    needs_review = ?
                WHERE l3_id = ? AND status = ?
                """,
                (
                    current_support,
                    current_confirmations,
                    current_conflicts,
                    current_confidence,
                    updated_at,
                    int(needs_review),
                    l3_id,
                    active_value,
                ),
            )

            deduped_nodes = list(dict.fromkeys(endpoint_node_ids))
            valid_nodes: list[str] = []
            for batch in _batched(deduped_nodes):
                placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
                cur = conn.execute(
                    f"SELECT node_id FROM graph_nodes WHERE node_id IN ({placeholders})",
                    batch,
                )
                valid_nodes.extend(r[0] for r in cur.fetchall())
            valid_node_set = set(valid_nodes)

            existing_nodes = {
                r[0]
                for r in conn.execute(
                    "SELECT source_id FROM l3_concept_sources WHERE l3_id = ? AND source_type = 'node'",
                    (l3_id,),
                ).fetchall()
            }
            to_add = [nid for nid in valid_nodes if nid not in existing_nodes]
            to_remove = [nid for nid in existing_nodes if nid not in valid_node_set]

            if to_add:
                conn.executemany(
                    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO l3_concept_sources (l3_id, source_type, source_id) "
                    "VALUES (?, 'node', ?)",
                    [(l3_id, nid) for nid in to_add],
                )
            for batch in _batched(to_remove):
                placeholders = ",".join("?" * len(batch))
                conn.execute(
                    f"DELETE FROM l3_concept_sources "
                    f"WHERE l3_id = ? AND source_type = 'node' AND source_id IN ({placeholders})",
                    (l3_id, *batch),
                )

            conn.commit()
            return {"updated": True, "nodes_added": len(to_add), "nodes_removed": len(to_remove)}
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def update_l3_hypothesis_dynamic_stats(
    *,
    l3_id: str,
    current_support: int,
    current_confirmations: int,
    current_conflicts: int,
    current_confidence: float | None,

def _mark_l3_hypothesis_retired_sync(
    l3_id: str, reason: str, retired_at: float, retired_value: str
) -> bool:
    conn = _get_connection()
    with _sql_lock:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        try:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM l3_hypotheses_provenance WHERE l3_id = ?", (l3_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise ValueError(f"mark_l3_hypothesis_retired 失敗:l3_id={l3_id} 不是已註冊的假說 L3")
            if row[0] == retired_value:
                conn.rollback()
                return False
            # 快照與刪除同一交易：來源清單先進旁掛表才釋放參照，保住「出處可回溯」。
            released = [
                {"source_type": r[0], "source_id": r[1]}
                for r in conn.execute(
                    "SELECT source_type, source_id FROM l3_concept_sources WHERE l3_id = ?", (l3_id,)
                ).fetchall()
            ]
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE l3_hypotheses_provenance SET status = ?, retired_at = ?, "
                "released_sources_json = ?, review_notes = review_notes || ? WHERE l3_id = ?",
                (retired_value, retired_at, _json_dumps(released), f"\n[retired] {reason}", l3_id),
            )
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM l3_concept_sources WHERE l3_id = ?", (l3_id,))
            conn.commit()
            return True
        except Exception:
            conn.rollback()
            raise


async def mark_l3_hypothesis_retired(*, l3_id: str, reason: str) -> bool:
    """純 SQLite 側退役：旁掛列轉 retired、來源快照、釋放 l3_concept_sources 參照
    （解除 purge 阻擋）。向量庫的刪除不在這裡，見 modules/l3_registry.retire_l3_concept。
    回傳 True＝本次完成退役；False＝先前已退役。非假說 L3 拋 ValueError。"""
